run_compute_scaling_factors: run compute_scaling_factors to fit all ScaleFactor modules in a model and save them to a checkpoint file
run_fit_cli: run the fit.py CLI module with --checkpoint and config args to compute scaling factors for a FairChem model
refactor_train_batch: refactor _train_batch to support custom loss computation or additional forward pass hooks
review_prefilled_input: review _prefilled_input which uses readline to prefill a prompt with default text before user input
summarize_compute_scaling_factors: summarize compute_scaling_factors which discovers ScaleFactor submodules, fits them in computation order, and saves results
